Package com.blank.template.audio.processing

Class AudioProcessing

java.lang.Object
com.blank.template.audio.processing.AudioProcessing
public class AudioProcessing extends Object
AudioProcessing class is responsible for processing the audio data Uses ExecutorService (Thread Pool) to process the audio data in a separate thread. And sends the data to the UI Thread via the UiAudioDispatcher.

  • Method Details

    • startProcessingLoop

      public void startProcessingLoop(@NotNull AudioCapture audioCapture)
      Starts the audio processing loop via the executor service. Audio chunks are read while capture is active, converted to normalized samples, and analyzed without blocking the main thread. The amount of Threads in the pool can be configured at AudioConfig.AUDIO_PROCESSING_FIXED_THREAD_POOL_SIZE
      Parameters:
      audioCapture - recorder used to obtain PCM audio chunks

    • onDestroy

      public void onDestroy()
      Stops accepting new processing work and shuts down the worker pool.
